name: Universal Dev Standards
headline: Universal Dev Standards - Enforce Coding Standards
short_description: Universal dev standards for code reviews, git workflows, and productivity. Engineers and teams use it to enforce best practices, improve code quality, and streamline workflows. Integrates with git, CI/CD pipelines, and IDEs.
author: AsiaOstrich

sections.overview:
Universal Dev Skills has been consolidated into the universal-dev-standards repository. The original 8 skills—including code review, commit standards, testing guides, and git workflows—are now maintained in a unified package with 6 additional skills. Install the npm package universal-dev-standards and run npx uds init to set up Claude Code skills for enforcing development best practices, improving code quality, and streamlining team workflows. Existing users should migrate by removing old skill installations and installing the new unified CLI tool.
Migrate from archived skills to universal-dev-standards
Set up automated code review checklists via Claude Code
Enforce Conventional Commits and semantic versioning standards
Configure git workflow and branching strategies
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AsiaOstrich/universal-dev-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a senior software engineer performing a code review for [PROJECT_NAME]. Review the following changes in [BRANCH_NAME]: [CODE_CHANGES]. Check for: 1) adherence to [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE] best practices, 2) potential bugs or edge cases, 3) performance implications, 4) security vulnerabilities, 5) test coverage gaps. Provide feedback in GitHub/GitLab review format with clear line-by-line comments and a summary section. Include suggestions for improvements and next steps for the author.
```
Copy

```
{"review":{"summary":"Overall, the changes in `feature/user-authentication` improve the authentication flow but introduce several critical issues that need addressing before merging. The implementation of JWT refresh tokens is a good step, but the lack of input validation and missing test cases for edge scenarios significantly increases risk. The PR also includes some minor style inconsistencies that should be cleaned up. I recommend addressing the critical issues first, then we can discuss the rest in a follow-up review.","line_comments":[{"line":42,"comment":"⚠️ SECURITY: The `generateToken` function doesn't validate the `userId` input. An attacker could pass a malformed ID to crash the service or inject malicious data. Add validation: `if (!isValidUUID(userId)) throw new Error('Invalid user ID')`.","severity":"critical"},{"line":67,"comment":"🔍 PERFORMANCE: The `refreshToken` endpoint queries the database twice in sequence. This could cause latency spikes under load. Consider batching these queries or using a single optimized query.","severity":"major"},{"line":89,"comment":"🧪 TESTING: No test cases for expired refresh tokens. Add a test in `auth.test.js` to verify the system handles expired tokens gracefully by returning a 401 response.","severity":"minor"},{"line":112,"comment":"📝 STYLE: Inconsistent spacing around operators. Follow the project's style guide (e.g., `token = generateToken(userId)` instead of `token=generateToken(userId)`).","severity":"trivial"}],"suggestions":["Implement input validation for all user-provided data in the auth flow.","Add unit tests for edge cases (e.g., invalid tokens, malformed payloads).","Optimize the refresh token query to reduce database round trips.","Run a security scan with `npm audit` and address any new vulnerabilities.","Fix style inconsistencies using `eslint --fix` before merging."],"next_steps":["Address critical and major issues in a new commit.","Rebase the branch to resolve conflicts with `main`.","Update the PR description with details of the changes made.","Request a re-review once the critical issues are resolved."]}}
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
sections.overview_vi:
Universal Dev Skills đã được hợp nhất vào repository universal-dev-standards. 8 skill ban đầu—bao gồm code review, tiêu chuẩn commit, tài liệu hướng dẫn kiểm thử và git workflow—hiện được duy trì trong một package thống nhất cùng với 6 skill bổ sung khác. Hãy cài đặt npm package universal-dev-standards và chạy lệnh npx uds init để thiết lập các skill của Claude Code nhằm áp dụng các best practice trong phát triển phần mềm, nâng cao chất lượng code và tối ưu hóa workflow của đội ngũ. Người dùng hiện tại nên thực hiện migrate bằng cách gỡ bỏ các cài đặt skill cũ và cài đặt công cụ CLI thống nhất mới.

Migrate từ các skill đã cũ (archived) sang universal-dev-standards
Thiết lập checklist tự động cho code review thông qua Claude Code
Áp dụng tiêu chuẩn Conventional Commits và semantic versioning
Cấu hình git workflow và chiến lược phân nhánh (branching strategy)

headline_vi: Universal Dev Standards - Áp dụng Tiêu chuẩn Coding
short_description_vi: Các tiêu chuẩn phát triển chung dành cho code review, git workflow và hiệu suất làm việc. Các kỹ sư và đội ngũ phát triển sử dụng công cụ này để áp dụng các best practice, nâng cao chất lượng code và tối ưu hóa workflow. Tích hợp tốt với git, CI/CD pipeline và các IDE.
